title: 11D Door Thesis — M-Theory, Compactification and Quantum Information
status: deepened archive-developed scientific synthesis: recovered project scaffold + explicit M-theory/IIA dictionary + G2 geometry + brane compactification + EFT + quantum information/recovery + holographic/matrix-theory comparators
core_thesis: The recovered 1–4D / 5D Door / 6–11D scaffold is strongest as a typed multi-description architecture. Its best literal comparator is a 4+1+6 M-theory-circle/Type-IIA branch; its best direct 11D→4D comparator is a 4+7 G2-holonomy compactification. Reduction is category conversion: higher-dimensional geometry, topology, flux and momentum become lower-dimensional fields, spectra, charges, couplings and moduli. Quantum reduction must be typed separately as lossy channel, effective truncation, recoverable encoding or exact duality.

key_insights: Spacetime dimension, Hilbert-space dimension, configuration-space dimension, spectral dimension and project grade are distinct quantities.
The six layers above the fifth Door should not be assigned universal physical ordinal roles; compactification physics is organized by geometry, topology, cycles, forms, holonomy, flux and moduli.
A hidden dimension becomes operationally visible when its KK excitation scale is resolvable, providing a rigorous scale-Door interpretation.
The radius/shape of compact space becomes lower-dimensional scalar moduli, providing a dynamical Door interpretation.
Quantum reduction can make a globally pure state appear mixed to an observer with access only to a subsystem.
Petz/approximate recovery supplies a rigorous replacement for vague cross-dimensional information-preservation claims.
Holonomy provides a mathematically deeper form of 'return changed' and is especially relevant because G2 is itself a holonomy group.
RG ascent/descent provides a serious physical comparator for the Dual Spirals: UV lifting resolves more degrees of freedom while IR coarse-graining integrates them out.
falsifiable_program: Specify metric, C3/G4 and fermionic/matter content.
Derive internal eigenmodes and 4D zero/KK spectrum.
Derive the 4D effective action and couplings.
Stabilize moduli rather than leaving compactification radii arbitrary.
Specify the quantum reduction channel and accessible observables.
Compute information retention/recoverability for a declared state family.
Produce at least one 4D observable that is not freely adjustable in generic EFT.
boundaries: The 1–11 project taxonomy is not experimentally established spacetime dimensionality.
11D spacetime does not mean an 11-dimensional Hilbert space.
S1×CY3 and a genuine G2-holonomy X7 are different compactification structures.
Entanglement is not evidence of controllable superluminal or backward-time signaling.
The 5D Door should not be called a physical portal without a specified geometry/dynamics.
M-theory does not assign universal meanings to physical coordinates D6 through D11.
11D supergravity is a low-energy limit/comparator; it is not a complete nonperturbative definition of M-theory.
